notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat steps 2 and/or 3 as mana allows.
